acceptance_predicates.description: TUI exposes bounded clone/build/install progress and exact revision identity.
Failed or cancelled installation leaves the prior installation usable and explains recovery.
Successful launch uses the versioned ASB control/environment handoff and diagnoses incompatibility.
Cancellation, failure, rollback, and remove leave no orphaned build processes or temporary artifacts.

definition_of_done: TUI materializer screens and lifecycle fixtures pass hosted checks and independent review.

gates.description: Install, cancel, rollback, remove, and launch-negative matrix passes.
